question_text: Describe how promptly updating networked clinic software can reduce the risk of malware damaging data.
adaptation_rationale: Retain software updates as an explicit countermeasure; do not map general backup policy as a required syllabus bullet. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Updates patch known vulnerabilities; malware cannot exploit the patched flaw to compromise files in that way.

marking_points.criterion: Removes known exploitable vulnerability, reducing compromise risk.
